name: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
description: A barbell complex linking a stiff-leg deadlift, a clean and a controlled step-up onto a low platform.
instructions: Stand in front of a low, stable step holding a light barbell at thigh height.
With soft knees and a neutral back, hinge at the hips to lower the bar along your legs, then stand back up.
Pull the bar close to your body and catch it in a front rack position.
Keeping the bar racked, step onto the platform with one foot, bring the other foot up, then step down carefully.
Lower the bar and reset before repeating, alternating the lead leg.
